llm_response.reason: The site exhibits multiple classic scam characteristics: it promises ROI up to 80%, instant withdrawals, guaranteed returns, and referral earnings—all unrealistic for legitimate investments. It uses fake testimonials and spoofed brand names like 'Swiss-Capital-Pro.' Contact is only through WhatsApp, not professional means. Ambiguous privacy policy, focus on crypto deposits, and targeting of psychological weaknesses further confirm this. No legitimate company information can be verified.
